title: 24 Bags, 300 Miles: How the $100M Brinks Heist Worked

lines.say: Twenty-four bags of jewelry, valued by the victims at a hundred million dollars. The lead defendant just pleaded guilty and admitted how.
lines.show: 24 bags of jewelry, valued by the victims at $100 million. The lead defendant just pleaded guilty and admitted how.

lines.say: A crew scouted a jewelry show, picked a Brinks truck with seventy-three bags, and followed it about three hundred miles.
lines.show: A crew scouted a jewelry show, picked a Brinks truck with 73 bags, and followed it about 300 miles.

scene.src: Plea agreement, U.S. v. Mestanza Cercado, Dkt. 158 (C.D. Cal., Nov 9, 2026)

lines.say: At a truck stop in Lebec, they broke the locks. Brinks's lawsuit said one driver slept, the other was getting food.

scene.src: Plea agreement, U.S. v. Mestanza Cercado, Dkt. 158 (C.D. Cal., Nov 9, 2026); Brinks lawsuit (2022), as reported by AP

lines.say: Then they switched off their phones. Charges took almost three years.

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Mestanza Cercado et al. (C.D. Cal., June 11, 2025)

lines.say: How did they think they'd get away with it?
